svg.title: Miel — honey
svg.desc: A plain shallow earthenware bowl filled with clear amber honey. A turned wooden dipper is raised above it, drawing a slender unbroken thread back to the liquid. A broken piece of golden comb shows open hexagonal wax cells and its thick cut edge; a small honeybee hovers to one side. Warm translucent washes and fine umber engraving describe the materials.
